description: This file defines the GraphQLMiddleware class, which handles GraphQL HTTP requests in an ASP.NET Core application. It manages request authentication, authorization, parsing GraphQL queries from HTTP requests, executing queries against a schema, and returning results.

classes.name: GraphQLMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling GraphQL HTTP requests, including authentication, authorization, request parsing, query execution, and response handling.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Main middleware method that processes incoming HTTP requests, checks if they are GraphQL requests, performs authentication and authorization, and executes GraphQL queries.

methods.name: IsGraphQLRequest
methods.description: Checks if the incoming request path matches the configured GraphQL endpoint path.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Parses the GraphQL request, executes the query against the schema, and writes the result to the HTTP response.

methods.name: CreateRequestFromQueryString
methods.description: Creates a GraphQL request object from query string parameters.
